notes.title: Henry Halfhead is OUT NOW! 👀✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The day has finally arrived! Henry Halfhead is here! 💜👃💜


After several years of scripting, creating, testing, and bug-fixing, we couldn’t be more excited to share the full story of our wonderful Halfhead with you all.


https://youtu.be/Tnhae9LMfC4


Here’s what awaits you in the game:
300+ objects to transform into, from loaves of bread to paper planes.

A heartfelt story about life’s little joys and oddities.

Play alone or with a friend in the local co-op mode

Puzzles, surprises, and plenty of reasons to experiment.

And of course, a few hidden secrets (have fun trying to find Bing Bong who is visiting from Peak).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/23c8e49625b9b7816330e65c6379df7277bb58b8.png"]

 

And for those jamming out to the music, the OST is available to purchase here on Steam, with all of the revenue going straight to the musician Lucien Guy Montandon:



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942680/Henry_Halfhead_Soundtrack/?curator_clanid=43807042"][/dynamiclink]



A big thank you to everyone who supported us throughout development! Making Henry Halfhead has been a weird, wonderful adventure, and it wouldn’t have been the same without such a kind and curious community along for the ride.

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/2d86c96bdba5ef75d048750a588b39d952062893.png"]


We would be most grateful if you help us spread the word about Henry Halfhead. 

Here’s how you can help:
Write a review on Steam

Tell your favorite content creators about Henry

Share our launch post on BlueSky, Instagram, TikTok and X



For those who share your favorite moments, clips, and screenshots online, feel free to tag us so we can enjoy it too!

Bluesky: ‪@lululu.games‬

TikTok: @lululuentertainment

Instagram: @lululuentertainment

Discord


If you come across any bugs or simply want to tell us how you liked the game, head over to our Discord or the Steam forums and let us know.


Thank you again for being part of this journey.





Enjoy and don’t forget to be yourselves,

- Aaron, Tim, Leander and Jan
Lululu Entertainment 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/a68cfbfbf0f0f1a2498f5fc8a97b5ad78691ecdd.gif"]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.15
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played the demo so far! It has been wonderful to read your feedback in the reviews, the forums and on Discord 😊



This is a small update for the demo. 

Most notably, this patch should fix the demo getting flagged by some antivirus programs by removing the reported files (which are of a plugin which we no longer use).



As a small treat we've added some stylish sunglasses to the level. They're a bit big for baby Henry but they look super cool! ✨



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/e98734594cf022e7690bc9cea0f6551612acd1a4.gif"]



List of changes:

Removed unused plugin which triggered some antivirus

Added fancy sunglasses to the level

Added a hand full of new narrator comments

Excluded settings from being synced over Steam Cloud Save (usually undesirable)

Fixed camera control with mouse on Linux

Fixed level loading screen flickers on Linux

Fixed debug input icons displaying when no controller is connected

Fixed bug where the door to the demo-ending would not appear when loading gamesave

Various other tweaks and bug fixes

notes.title: Henry is coming 2025!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/6d55a66de73d123c3617cbb1d0e44aeda2472df1.png

Hello hello!

We're very happy to announce that:

 Henry Halfhead will launch this year 👀

We know the game has been in development for a while. We're a small team, we are working part time on the game and we really want to make the best version of the game we can! We are in the finishing stretches of development and can't wait to share more of the game with you! 

Like finding and planting a seed, the game has been set in soil a long time ago and is almost fully grown!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/b8d6b19b4470e8ff1b3d305ce48cbda1681a29e6.gif

We hope you are as excited for the game as we are having fun making it. 

Best,

Tim, Aaron and Leander
Lululu Entertainment


PS: You might get a taste of Henry Halfhead very soon!

notes.title: REVEALING: HENRY HALFHEAD 👀🍎🌞
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/a68cfbfbf0f0f1a2498f5fc8a97b5ad78691ecdd.gif


Hey there!

We are very excited to show you our new game Henry Halfhead. We've been working on the game for a while and are super stoked for the world to see it. 

Henry has been growing close to our hearts and we hope that you share our enthusiasm about becoming EVERYTHING!

Our plan is to release Henry Halfhead next year on Steam. Until then, we're looking forward to sharing more about Henry's life and their world with you.


If you like the game, please consider wishlisting it! 👀🍎🌞🧡

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058140/Henry_Halfhead/


Follow us on Twitter for the newest news and join our Discord to let us know your thoughts about the game. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807042/6d55a66de73d123c3617cbb1d0e44aeda2472df1.png



Who are we?

We are three Game Design graduates from Switzerland with a passion for quirky and weird games! We founded Lululu Entertainment together and released our first game Bamerang in 2021 on Steam and Switch. Bamerang is a local multiplayer boomerang fighting game, check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/



Thank you and have a wonderful weekend!

Team Lululu
